title: potentilla fragiformis var. lucida
intro: Potentilla fragiformis var. lucida, commonly known as the Shining Cinquefoil, is a perennial herb plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues due to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Potentilla fragiformis var. lucida include reducing inflammation, alleviating symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, and exhibiting potential antiviral and antibacterial activities. Its therapeutic actions involve the bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and tannins, which may help modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant effects, providing protection against oxidative stress.
